packet_dag.terminal_condition: Scoped audit findings are fixed, verified, committed, pushed, deployed, and live-smoked; external/account-owner/private-data findings remain explicitly blocked.

title: Audit Fix Implementation Batch

reasons: The operator asked Codex to implement fixes from multiple audits.
The current visual audit reports action-control height spread and missing admin/provider identity on scoped routes.
The operator explicitly asked for deployment in an organized way.
Several audit outputs are external-provider or private-data blockers and must stay separate from code fixes.
affected_product_surfaces: One Time role UI audit harness
likely_external_provider_blockers: WAPI/Whapi phonebook/sync requires exact instance and phone aliases.
Drive/private recording reprocess requires exact private-data approval.
Payments, DNS, external sends, provider writes, and credential mutations require exact approved packets.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Finish the scoped control-height, admin-provider banner, and audit output folder fixes, then rerun the role UI visual audit.

operator_intent_summary: Shloimie wants the current audit findings implemented and shipped in an orderly release: fix safe UI/code defects, verify them with desktop/mobile evidence, deploy, and keep credential/private/external-account findings blocked.
raw_quotes: deploy them in a clean organized way

decisions_captured.decision: Treat broad audit-fix language as permission to implement safe scoped code fixes, not as permission for external sends, DNS, payments, credentials, provider writes, raw private data commits, or blind artifact staging.

out_of_scope: External email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, DNS, provider-account, credential, access-grant, Drive sync, Vimeo upload, or Stripe mutation.
Committing raw private message bodies, contact exports, student/parent private records, secrets, or raw private screenshots.
Blindly staging repeated ChatGPT pickup/dropoff generated artifacts.
Broad redesign outside the scoped Operations/provider visual audit findings.
affected_surfaces: One Time provider/admin preview identity and return affordance
One Time role UI audit harness

inspection_targets: Current role UI audit report and screenshots
Provider admin-provider banner rendering in normal, permission denied, and session-required states
known_findings: Action-height spread findings remain on scoped Operations/provider captures.
Provider admin mailbox captures miss the admin-on-provider banner in denied/session-required states.
The audit runner accepted --out but not --out-dir before this pass.
known_blockers: Drive/private transcript reprocess remains private-data/account blocked.
Payments, DNS, external sends, credential changes, and provider writes remain approval-gated.

expanded_phrases.all those audits: Classify each current audit output as fixable now, already satisfied, superseded, generated noise, or externally blocked before coding.
expanded_phrases.implement all of the fixes: Apply only safe scoped code/UI/tooling fixes that have current evidence and do not require account-owner approval.
expanded_phrases.clean: Stage and release a narrow verified batch without clobbered proof folders, unrelated generated artifacts, secrets, or private data.
expanded_phrases.organized: Keep requirements, blockers, proof, commit, deployment, and live smoke tied to stable IDs.
expanded_phrases.deploy: Push the scoped commit, trigger the approved release path, wait for terminal deployment success, and live-smoke affected routes before Done.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Operations and One Time provider surfaces should share first-party BNA role-scoped control patterns; external-provider setup is separated into blocked packets.

requirements.statement: Capture and validate the audit-fix request before final release closeout.
requirements.expected_result: Raw intake, register, and Product Quality packet exist and validate.

requirements.statement: Classify audit outputs before coding or staging generated artifacts.
requirements.expected_result: Safe UI/tooling findings are separated from already satisfied, superseded, generated-noise, and external/private blockers.
acceptance_criteria: Blocked external/provider/private findings name owner and next action.
No repeated pickup/dropoff artifact flood is staged blindly.

requirements.statement: Normalize scoped Operations/provider visible action sizing and wrapping.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop, tablet, and mobile captures no longer show action-control height spread on the scoped routes.
acceptance_criteria: Operations workspace controls have stable minimum heights and centered labels.
Operations Rabbi email inbox controls wrap without uneven pill heights.
Provider entry controls preserve consistent tap targets.

requirements.statement: Keep admin-as-provider identity visible in provider denied and session-required states.
requirements.expected_result: The admin/provider banner and return action are visible whenever the provider admin-preview URL is loaded.
acceptance_criteria: Provider admin mailbox desktop and mobile captures include admin-on-Rabbi context.
The return-to-Operations affordance is visible before and after session checks.
No Rabbi/student/provider private data is exposed to the wrong scope.

requirements.statement: Support explicit audit output folders without clobbering prior proof.
requirements.expected_result: The role UI audit supports --out-dir and --out consistently.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh after-audit folder is created by --out-dir.
Prior default audit folders are not overwritten during final proof generation.

requirements.statement: Release only the verified scoped audit fixes.
requirements.expected_result: The focused batch is tested, committed, pushed, deployed, and live-smoked.
acceptance_criteria: Syntax/test/watchdog/audit checks pass or exact blockers are documented.
Staged files are intentional and do not include secrets/private data/unrelated artifact floods.
Live smoke confirms the deployed commit.

requirements.expected_result: Unsafe or external-owner audit findings are recorded as blockers, not Done.
acceptance_criteria: WAPI/Whapi, Drive/private transcript, payment, DNS, external-send, provider-write, and credential items remain approval-gated.
Each blocker has owner, recommended next action, and consequence.

criteria: Current-state visual audit evidence exists from the role UI harness.
Executable findings are limited to two routes and one QA script.
External/provider/private-data blockers are out of implementation scope.
Deployment/live smoke is required before app-visible Done.

loading.how_to_enter_state: Load Operations One Time workspace before data panels finish hydrating.
loading.expected_visible_message: Workspace chrome renders without jumping or uneven controls.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Tappable controls stay at least 40px high.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: No action height spread above threshold during initial capture.

empty.how_to_enter_state: Open Rabbi email inbox with no messages matching the current filter.
empty.expected_visible_message: No matching messages are displayed with aligned controls.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty state is announced near inbox controls.
empty.accessibility_expectation: Filter and refresh controls remain keyboard reachable.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Email inbox controls pass height-spread threshold.

populated.how_to_enter_state: Open provider admin-preview mailbox route with valid or preview session context.
populated.expected_visible_message: Admin is viewing Rabbi/provider context and can return to Operations.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: Admin/provider context is announced near the page heading.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Apply a workspace filter that has no matching cards.
filtered_empty.expected_visible_message: No matching items without layout collapse.
filtered_empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Filtered-empty message is associated with filters.
filtered_empty.accessibility_expectation: Clear action remains visible and reachable.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Filter controls remain stable after no-result state.

error.how_to_enter_state: Simulate provider session lookup error or failed session read.
error.expected_visible_message: Admin/provider context remains visible even when session read fails.
error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error message does not hide admin context.
error.test_smoke_assertion: Admin banner persists in error-like state.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Open provider admin-preview mailbox when local setup lacks a provider session.
blocked_setup.expected_visible_message: Admin preview is opening or blocked while context remains visible.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Blocked setup status is tied to the preview banner.
blocked_setup.accessibility_expectation: Return action is tappable at mobile width.
blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: Admin banner detector passes in blocked setup.

preview_only.how_to_enter_state: Open the admin-provider route at narrow mobile width.
preview_only.expected_visible_message: Preview/admin context is visible and mobile controls fit.
preview_only.aria_semantic_expectation: Mobile banner and controls have accessible names.
preview_only.accessibility_expectation: Controls are at least 40px tall and do not overlap.
preview_only.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile capture passes banner and action-height checks.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Run npm run audit:onetime-role-ui with --out-dir pointing to a new folder.
success_readback.expected_visible_message: Report is written to the requested after-audit folder.
forbidden_content: Default proof folder clobbered by final run
success_readback.aria_semantic_expectation: Not applicable to terminal report generation.
success_readback.accessibility_expectation: Generated accessibility snapshots are stored with the report.
success_readback.test_smoke_assertion: Requested output directory exists and contains report.md/report.json.

permission_denied.how_to_enter_state: Open the admin-provider route without a valid provider session.
permission_denied.expected_visible_message: Permission/session issue is shown while admin/provider context remains visible.
permission_denied.aria_semantic_expectation: Permission state and return action are visible to assistive tech.
permission_denied.accessibility_expectation: Permission denied state has clear action and no hidden credential fields.
permission_denied.test_smoke_assertion: Permission-denied capture passes admin banner detector.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.how_to_enter_state: Open Operations One Time workspace at mobile width with filters/actions visible.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.expected_visible_message: Mobile filters and action buttons wrap predictably without uneven rows.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: Mobile menu/filter controls retain accessible names.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.accessibility_expectation: Tap targets remain at least 40px high.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile Operations capture passes action-height threshold.

findings.user_impact: Controls look uneven and reduce confidence in the role-specific workspace on desktop and mobile.
findings.expected_fix: Normalize action-control min heights, wrapping, line-height, and centering across scoped Operations/provider controls.

findings.user_impact: Super admin can lose the visual proof that they are viewing the provider/Rabbi account instead of their own account.
findings.expected_fix: Render admin-provider banner and return action before and after provider session checks, including permission denied and session-required states.

requirements: All affected controls remain keyboard reachable.
Visible buttons and links keep accessible names.
Mobile tap targets are at least 40px tall.
Permission/session states do not hide the return action.
verification: ARIA text snapshots generated by audit harness
